about: Border widths (mm, from the card edge to where the border ends, at the middle of each side) of PSA-graded card scans from huggingface.co/datasets/jyesr/pokemon-tcg-grading (fetch: scripts/fetch-grade-data.mjs). outer: the card corners in scan pixels (TL, TR, BR, BL). by: who set the values; method: agree = two independent measurements agreed within 0.12 mm, review = set after looking at the border (scripts/annotate-grade.mjs shows and corrects them).
